summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Board of Directors declared Interest on Equity (IoE) for Q2 2026 totaling R$ 200,000,000 (approx. R$ 0.28096472120 per share). The record date for B3 shareholders is June 23, 2026, with ex-IoE dates of June 24, 2026 (B3) and July 2, 2026 (NYSE). Payment is scheduled for May 24, 2027, with no adjustment or additional remuneration. The IoE will be imputed to mandatory dividends for the fiscal year. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, not a special situation involving structural corporate change. No premium, advisor, or strategic review is involved.
